tests.name: New user can sign up and lands on a funded dashboard
tests.summary:
Registered a new account using the name Kane Tester, email kanevzs9oa@mlyfo.app, and username kanevzs9oa.
Confirmed that the username @kanevzs9oa was available, then entered the password and created the account.
The account was created successfully and opened the welcome page for Kane, showing a wallet balance of $500.00.

tests.name: New user can sign up and lands on a funded dashboard
tests.summary:
Completed the registration form with the requested name, email address, and username.
Confirmed that @kanevzs9v1 was available.
Entered the requested password and created the account.
The account page opened with the heading “Welcome, Kane” and a wallet balance of $500.00.

tests.name: Split a $236 bill four ways and get a link per person
tests.summary:
Created the requested split for “Kane dinner vzs7gp” with a total of $236 and participants zoya, kabir, and sofia.
Confirmed the split was divided among 4 people at $59.00 each.
Created the split successfully; it is listed as “1 of 4 paid.”
Confirmed that zoya, kabir, and sofia each owe $59.00 and each has a Copy link button.

tests.name: Shield blocks a look-alike of a saved contact's address
tests.summary:
Signed in and opened the Shield address-check page.
Entered the provided address and selected “Check address.”
The address was marked “Blocked,” with a warning that it looks like Ada’s saved address but is not.

tests.name: Shield blocks a look-alike of a saved contact's address
tests.summary:
You asked to sign in, open the Shield page, and check the provided wallet address.
The Shield page was opened and the address AdaK9zXw2LmQ8rTvB3nYc7HsP4kJe6FgD1oWu5Ra2Fx was submitted for checking.
The result marked the address as “Blocked” and warned that it resembles Ada’s saved address but is not the same address.

tests.name: A payment over the spend limit waits for password confirmation
tests.summary:
Requested a $150 rent payment to @ada.
Entered “pay @ada 150 for rent” and selected the $150 payment option.
Reviewed the confirmation showing that the payment exceeded the $100 per-payment limit and the $25 limit for new recipients, then entered the provided password to confirm.
The payment was completed, and the page showed “Sent $150.00 to @ada.”

tests.name: Shield flags a fake Phantom airdrop link as dangerous
tests.summary:
You asked to check https://phantorn-airdrop.app/claim using the site’s Quick check feature.
Entered the link and ran the quick check.
The result marked the link as Dangerous and explained that the address imitates Phantom rather than being the real site.

tests.name: Shield flags a fake Phantom airdrop link as dangerous
tests.summary:
The requested link, https://phantorn-airdrop.app/claim, was entered and checked.
The scan marked the link as Dangerous.
The reasons stated that the address imitates Phantom but is not the real site.

tests.name: Shield refuses to save a look-alike of a saved person
tests.summary:
Attempted to add a person named “Ada new” with the provided wallet address.
Clicked “Save person.”
The page reported that the address was not saved because it looked like Ada’s saved address.
“Ada new” was not added to the list of people.

tests.name: Paying a name that is both a saved person and another user asks who you meant
tests.summary:
Requested a $5 payment to Semi for coffee.
Entered “pay semi 5 for coffee” and selected the “Pay $5.00” option.
The page asked which Semi was intended and showed both “Your contact Semi” and “Mlyfo user @semi.”
Selected “Your contact Semi,” and the page confirmed: “Sent $5.00 to Semi.”

tests.name: A payment gives a receipt with an ID and a public receipt page
tests.summary:
Opened the Receipt link from Recent activity.
The receipt page confirmed a $10.00 payment marked paid to @kabir.
The receipt ID was shown as MLY-B96R-T3BR.

tests.name: A payment gives a receipt with an ID and a public receipt page
tests.summary:
Opened the Receipt link from Recent activity as requested.
The receipt page confirmed a $10.00 payment to @kabir.
The receipt ID was shown as MLY-AP6T-E32G, beginning with “MLY-”.

tests.name: The Android keyboard hands a copied address to Shield
tests.summary:
The requested sign-in action was completed, then the supplied address-check link was opened.
The Shield page displayed the provided address in the address field.
The address check finished with a “Blocked” result and warned that it looks like Ada’s saved address but is not.
The requested address-check outcome was successfully shown.

tests.name: The Android keyboard hands a copied address to Shield
tests.summary:
You asked to sign in and check the provided wallet address in Shield.
The sign-in button was selected, and the provided address was opened in Shield.
Shield displayed the address AdaK9zXw2LmQ8rTvB3nYc7HsP4kJe6FgD1oWu5Ra2Fx and marked the result as “Blocked.”
The page warned that the address looks like Ada’s saved address but is not the saved address.

tests.name: Shield blocks a look-alike of a saved Ethereum and Base address
tests.summary:
You asked to sign in, open the Shield page, and check the provided wallet address.
The address was entered and checked on the Shield page.
The result marked the address as “Blocked,” said it resembles Ada (Base)’s saved address but is not, and labelled it for both Ethereum and Base.

tests.name: Shield blocks a look-alike of a saved Ethereum and Base address
tests.summary:
Opened the Shield address-check page after selecting Sign in.
Checked the address 0x7a3f9cE5b801Dd3fA7426C9e0B1f8a5d3e27c4b9.
The address was marked Blocked, identified as an Ethereum and Base address, and warned that it resembles Ada (Base)’s saved address but is not the saved address.
